description: Second bounded three-trial nearest-union probe of the shared QKV map
proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,426 parameters at 99.100000%, a +0.100000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 95 prior macro-attempts in this family and 729 prior micro-trials. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0197/micro-0003 at 1,426 parameters and 99.10%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0194/micro-0002, an FF-output union discarded at 98.91%. This macro tests at most three sequential minimum-distance scalar unions in the depth-shared QKV transform, excluding unchanged QKV pairs already rejected. Hypothesis: the largest tied tensor may still contain very close scalar groups after embedding-site compression. This is more informative than the nearest untested alternative because each candidate is the current minimum-distortion eligible QKV union and directly tests whether the earlier QKV success band continues after independent positional reductions, while bounding adaptation to three trials. Stop on the first discard/error, exhaustion, or cap; official acceptance and rollback remain solely controlled by the runner.
summary: All three bounded QKV unions qualified, reducing the retained frontier from 1,426 to 1,423 parameters; the final authorized trial retained 99.080000%. The automation stopped exactly at its declared three-trial cap.
